columns.label: Digital Employee
columns.title: Long-term agent memory should preserve primary evidence before semantic judgments mutate storage
columns.title_zh: 长期 Agent Memory 应先保留 Primary Evidence，再让语义判断改变存储角色
columns.source_zh: ROAM 一手研究：以独立、等价、包含、冲突等显式语义关系组织 Atomic Memory，将 Active Primary 与 Supporting Evidence 分离，并在检索视图层融合信息
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260911-007 after Skill 02 triage. ROAM exposes a bounded governance failure in long-lived memory: one LLM operation that both interprets semantic relations and directly rewrites or deletes stored observations couples judgment to destructive state mutation, weakening auditability and recovery. Its mechanism preserves atomic observations, classifies explicit relations, separates active Primary memories from supporting Evidence, and performs richer fusion at retrieval time; the paper reports up to 29.8 percentage-point answer-accuracy improvement, 15.6-point higher answer-critical source recall and 11.5-point lower confounder-token share. The Digital Employee research question is therefore which semantic decisions may change an active memory view without destroying the underlying evidence needed to audit, reverse or reinterpret that decision. This is materially distinct from the September 8 memory-migration object, which tested semantic portability across model/embedding upgrades, and from the September 10 MeClear candidate, which suppresses a harmful retrieved coalition for a task; today's object concerns the persistent store's own evidence-preserving organization under equivalence, subsumption and conflict.
columns.reason_zh: 经 Skill 02 筛选后选自 SIG-20260911-007。ROAM 暴露了长期记忆中的一个有界治理失败：如果同一次 LLM 操作既判断新旧记忆的语义关系，又直接改写或删除底层 Observation，就会把语义裁决与破坏性状态变更绑定在一起，使审计与恢复变弱。其机制保留 Atomic Observation，显式分类独立、等价、包含与冲突关系，把 Active Primary Memory 与 Supporting Evidence 分开，并把更丰富的融合放到 Retrieval-time View；论文报告最高 29.8 个百分点的 Answer Accuracy 提升、15.6 点更高的 Answer-critical Source Recall，以及 11.5 点更低的 Confounder-token Share。因此，数字员工的有界研究问题是：哪些语义判断可以改变当前有效 Memory View，同时不销毁未来审计、回滚或重新解释该判断所需的底层证据。它与 9 月 8 日 Memory Migration 对象实质不同，后者研究 Model/Embedding 升级后的语义可移植性；也不同于 9 月 10 日 MeClear Candidate，后者针对单次任务抑制有害 Retrieved Memory Coalition；今天研究的是持久 Memory Store 在等价、包含与冲突关系下如何保持 Evidence-preserving Organization。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify ROAM's atomic-memory representation, relation taxonomy and classifier, Primary/Evidence state transitions, retrieval-view fusion, conflict and temporal-update handling, datasets and baselines, the reported 29.8/15.6/11.5-point results, ablations, storage-growth and latency costs, whether underlying observations are truly non-destructive under every transition, and limits on generalizing benchmark memory quality to production authorization or truth.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 需核验 ROAM 的 Atomic Memory 表示、Relation Taxonomy 与 Classifier、Primary/Evidence 状态转换、Retrieval-view Fusion、Conflict 与 Temporal Update 处理、Dataset 与 Baseline、报告的 29.8/15.6/11.5 点结果、Ablation、存储增长与延迟成本、每类转换是否都真正保留底层 Observation，以及把 Benchmark Memory Quality 推广到生产 Authorization 或 Truth 时的边界。

columns.label: Industry Architecture
columns.title: Deterministic coordination should replace generative management only where units and coupling are observable
columns.title_zh: 只有在 Unit 与耦合关系可观察时，确定性协调才适合替代生成式 Manager
columns.source_zh: UnitBoost 一手研究：把 Worker Output 映射为任务定义 Unit，以受约束 Argmax 做无序依赖的确定性组装，保留 Unit Provenance，并把未支持 Slot 变成显式 Residual
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260911-005 after Skill 02 triage. UnitBoost asks a question-first architecture problem rather than presenting another manager agent: which coordination decisions actually require generative semantic arbitration, and which can be moved into an observable deterministic operator? It maps worker outputs to task-defined units, uses constrained argmax to assemble accepted slot values independent of arrival order, records unit provenance and carries unsupported slots forward as explicit residual work. The authors report improvement across six compound-system configurations and a FanOutQA residual-round gain from 0.4778 to 0.5524 cell F1, while also identifying measurable conditions where the mechanism cannot help. The bounded Industry Architecture question is therefore how to draw the boundary between semantic management and deterministic coordination without falsely assuming that every multi-agent decision can be mechanized. This is distinct from the September 10 self-evolving-procedure object, which governs adoption of model-proposed structural changes through held-out validation; today's object asks which manager functions should be deterministic in the first place and what observability assumptions make that safe and testable. SIG-20260911-006 is retained as a strong comparison candidate because it keeps rule/LLM policy pluggable behind stable executor/provenance boundaries, but the single Industry slot goes to UnitBoost's sharper counterfactual against a generative meta-manager and its explicit failure conditions.
columns.reason_zh: 经 Skill 02 筛选后选自 SIG-20260911-005。UnitBoost 不是再增加一个 Manager Agent，而是从问题出发追问：哪些协调决定真的需要生成式语义裁决，哪些可以移入可观察的确定性算子。它把 Worker Output 映射到任务定义 Unit，用受约束 Argmax 在不依赖到达顺序的情况下组装已接受 Slot，记录 Unit Provenance，并把未被支持的 Slot 作为显式 Residual 留给后续轮次。作者报告在 6 种 Compound-system Configuration 上获得改进，并将 FanOutQA 的 Cell F1 从 0.4778 提升到 0.5524，同时给出该机制无法获益的可测条件。因此，行业架构的有界研究问题是：如何划分 Semantic Management 与 Deterministic Coordination 的边界，而不错误地假设所有 Multi-Agent 决策都可以机械化。它与 9 月 10 日 Self-evolving Procedure 对象实质不同：后者研究 Model 提出的结构修改如何通过 Held-out Validation 获得采纳；今天研究的是哪些 Manager Function 一开始就应当确定化，以及这种确定化成立所需的 Observability Assumption。SIG-20260911-006 作为强比较 Candidate 保留，因为 Avatar 让 Rule/LLM Policy 在稳定 Executor/Provenance Boundary 后可插拔；但行业栏唯一名额优先给 UnitBoost，因为它对 Generative Meta-manager 提供了更直接的反事实比较，并明确暴露 Failure Condition。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify UnitBoost's unit abstraction, constrained-argmax operator, order-invariance claim, provenance representation, residual construction and later-round allocation, six compound-system configurations, held-out benchmark protocol, FanOutQA 0.4778-to-0.5524 result, all reported negative conditions, sensitivity to coupled or non-decomposable tasks, and what deterministic selection does not prove about semantic correctness.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 需核验 UnitBoost 的 Unit Abstraction、Constrained-argmax Operator、Order-invariance 声明、Provenance 表示、Residual 构造与后续轮次分配、6 种 Compound-system Configuration、Held-out Benchmark Protocol、FanOutQA 0.4778→0.5524 结果、全部 Negative Condition、对强耦合或不可分解任务的敏感性，以及 Deterministic Selection 不能证明哪些 Semantic Correctness 结论。

columns.label: Open-source Engineering
columns.reason: No Selection. SIG-20260911-003 provides concrete merged implementation evidence that a long-running thread should refresh authoritative instructions at model-request boundaries and bind new subagents/reviewer reuse to the applied instruction snapshot, but it remains one maintainer implementation without independent comparison and therefore stays below Skill 02's preferred evidence-sufficiency threshold. SIG-20260911-004 is also concrete implementation evidence, but its produced-versus-delivered-versus-replayable result distinction is another instance of the durable recovery / replay-safety problem already selected on September 4 and explicitly treated as duplicate evidence on September 9-10. SIG-20260911-001's per-call allow/ask/deny mechanism similarly overlaps the September 2 layered call-time authority object and is not elevated as a new Daily research problem.
columns.reason_zh: No Selection。SIG-20260911-003 提供了具体的 Merged Implementation Evidence：Long-running Thread 应在 Model-request Boundary 刷新权威指令，并把新 Subagent 与 Reviewer Reuse 绑定到实际应用的 Instruction Snapshot；但目前仍只有一个 Maintainer Implementation，缺少独立比较，因此未达到 Skill 02 偏好的 Evidence Sufficiency 门槛。SIG-20260911-004 同样是具体实现证据，但其 Produced / Delivered / Replayable Result 分离，本质上仍属于 9 月 4 日已选中的 Durable Recovery / Replay-safety 问题，并且 9 月 9–10 日已经把同类证据明确作为 Duplicate 处理。SIG-20260911-001 的逐调用 allow/ask/deny 机制也与 9 月 2 日已经研究的 Layered Call-time Authority 对象高度重叠，不再提升为新的 Daily Research Problem。
columns.next: Retain SIG-20260911-003 as a candidate for a future cross-sample study of policy revision identity, request-boundary re-admission and subagent inheritance. Treat SIG-20260911-004 and SIG-20260911-001 as additional evidence for existing recovery/replay and layered call-time authorization lines rather than new Daily objects. Reading must perform no separate Open-source Engineering Deep Reading for this run.
columns.next_zh: 保留 SIG-20260911-003 为 Candidate，等待围绕 Policy Revision Identity、Request-boundary Re-admission 与 Subagent Inheritance 的跨样本比较；将 SIG-20260911-004 与 SIG-20260911-001 分别作为既有 Recovery/Replay 与 Layered Call-time Authorization 研究线的追加证据，而不是新的 Daily Object。本轮 Reading 不得为 Open-source Engineering 单独执行 Deep Reading。
